plugin.name: Selfie
plugin.description: Generate character selfies from a reference image and share them in chat.
entry.name: Send a selfie
entry.description: Generate and share a selfie of yourself using the configured character reference. Call when the user asks for your selfie or when you choose to share one during conversation. Describe the scene, pose, outfit and expression; keep the reference character identity. Costs one image generation request. Do not claim success until the tool reports submission. Do not repeat after a cooldown or delivery error.
entry.scene: Desired scene, pose, outfit and expression for the character selfie.
result.submitted: The selfie was generated and submitted to chat; display has not been acknowledged.
error.config: Configure a valid provider, HTTPS API endpoint, image-to-image model, API key and reference image.
error.scene: Provide a non-empty selfie scene of at most 4000 characters.
error.busy: A selfie is already being generated. Try again after it finishes.
error.cooldown: Selfie generation is cooling down. Wait before another request.
error.response: The image provider returned an invalid response.
error.http: The image service request failed. Check connectivity and provider settings.
error.too_large: The image or response exceeds the size limit.
error.image: The returned image is invalid or its URL is not allowed.
error.reference: The reference image could not be read.
error.no_image: The provider did not return an image.
error.upload: The image could not be uploaded to the host.
error.delivery: The selfie was generated but chat submission failed. Do not report it as sent.
error.internal: The selfie operation failed. Check plugin configuration and try again later.
config.base_url: HTTPS API base URL or complete endpoint
config.reference_image: Reference image path or HTTPS URL
config.help: Configure one provider and a fixed character reference. Chat accepts a v1 base URL or complete chat endpoint. Relative reference paths are resolved from this plugin directory. Target character also scopes the AI tool.
